headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles in a 3-5 showdown, and the Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds. In other news, the San Francisco Giants placed Victor Bericoto on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Victor Bericoto of the San Francisco Giants, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left oblique strain. Other injured players include Mick Abel of the Minnesota Twins, Zack Gelof of the Athletics, Mark Vientos of the New York Mets, Jake Irvin of the Washington Nationals, Matt McLain of the Cincinnati Reds, Tanner Banks of the Philadelphia Phillies, and Brad Lord of the Washington Nationals.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-hander Brandon Eisert, acquired in a trade with the Chicago White Sox. The Pirates also acquired first baseman Jacob Gonzalez in the deal. In another trade, the Minnesota Twins acquired right-hander Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with the Tigers dominating the game from start to finish. Derek Hill led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals in their latest matchup. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles in their recent matchup. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 4-0 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, marking their final score. Hunter Greene led the Reds' pitching effort with 7.0 innings pitched, 12 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Victor Bericoto on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right fielder Victor Bericoto has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The injury occurred on July 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-hander Brandon Eisert, acquired in a trade with the Chicago White Sox. Eisert joins the Pirates along with first baseman Jacob Gonzalez in exchange for left-hander Jaden Woods and future considerations.
